hebrewText: וְ/רָאָ֣ה הַ/כֹּהֵ֗ן וְ/הִנֵּ֤ה שְׂאֵת לְבָנָה֙ בָּ/ע֔וֹר וְ/הִ֕יא הָפְכָ֖ה שֵׂעָ֣ר לָבָ֑ן וּ/מִֽחְיַ֛ת בָּשָׂ֥ר חַ֖י בַּ/שְׂאֵֽת

tokens.bdb: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
tokens.kjv: advise self, appear, approve, behold, [idiom] certainly, consider, discern, (make to) enjoy, have experience, gaze, take heed, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] joyfully, lo, look (on, one another, one on another, one upon another, out, up, upon), mark, meet, [idiom] be near, perceive, present, provide, regard, (have) respect, (fore-, cause to, let) see(-r, -m, one another), shew (self), [idiom] sight of others, (e-) spy, stare, [idiom] surely, [idiom] think, view, visions.
tokens.explanation: raah — ver, observar, contemplar, perceber, entender

tokens.bdb: literally one officiating, a priest; also (by courtesy) an acting priest (although a layman)
tokens.kjv: chief ruler, [idiom] own, priest, prince, principal officer.

tokens.explanation: hinneh — interjeição de atenção: eis, veja, olha!

tokens.bdb: an elevation or leprous scab; figuratively, elation or cheerfulness; exaltation in rank or character
tokens.kjv: be accepted, dignity, excellency, highness, raise up self, rising.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: an elevation or leprous scab; figuratively
tokens.enLiteralWord: an elevation or leprous scab; figuratively
tokens.explanation: an elevation or leprous scab; figuratively
tokens.explanationEn: an elevation or leprous scab; figuratively

tokens.bdb: skin (as naked); by implication, hide, leather

he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
tokens.kjv: he, as for her, him(-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (...it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self

tokens.bdb: to turn about or over; by implication, to change, overturn, return, pervert
tokens.kjv: [idiom] become, change, come, be converted, give, make (a bed), overthrow (-turn), perverse, retire, tumble, turn (again, aside, back, to the contrary, every way).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to turn about or over; by implication
tokens.enLiteralWord: to turn about or over; by implication
tokens.explanation: to turn about or over; by implication
tokens.explanationEn: to turn about or over; by implication

tokens.bdb: preservation of life; hence, sustenance; also the live flesh, i.e. the quick
tokens.kjv: preserve life, quick, recover selves, reviving, sustenance, victuals.

tokens.bdb: flesh (from its freshness); by extension, body, person; also (by euphemistically) the pudenda of aman
tokens.kjv: body, (fat, lean) flesh(-ed), kin, (man-) kind, [phrase] nakedness, self, skin.

tokens.bdb: alive; hence, raw (flesh); fresh (plant, water, year), strong; also (as noun, especially in the feminine singular and masculine plural) life (or living thing), whether literally or figuratively
tokens.kjv: [phrase] age, alive, appetite, (wild) beast, company, congregation, life(-time), live(-ly), living (creature, thing), maintenance, [phrase] merry, multitude, [phrase] (be) old, quick, raw, running, springing, troop.
tokens.explanation: chai — vivo, vivente, ser que tem vida
